Daniel, saw Snappt's 2026 Fraud Report and the TurboTenant partnership expanding your reach.

New data and partnerships usually open more in-market accounts than a regional team can cover, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Snappt off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Daniel, quick follow-up for Snappt.

With fresh demand from the fraud report, the territory number usually climbs faster than the team can. Most teams can't say how many meetings they need to book to hit target, so coverage gaps surface late and the quarter slips.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your region needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Daniel, last bit of proof for Snappt.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Snappt's reply rate likely compares to other proptech startups. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
